title: Bar Salts Blueberry Raspberry Strawberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape Bar Salts Blueberry Raspberry Strawberry combines the ripe, juicy pop of Blueberry, the tangy punch of Raspberry, and the soft, summery sweetness of fresh Strawberry. Balanced with a subtle sour edge, this vibrant berry medley delivers a layered and satisfying vape experience perfect for fans of multi-layered fruit flavours. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG blend, Vampire Vape Bar Salts offer the ideal balance of flavour and vapour production, making them perfect for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices like vape starter kits and refillable pod kits . These nic salts provide smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, mimicking the immediate satisfaction and intense, concentrated flavours associated with disposable vapes. Designed as a sustainable alternative to disposable vape bars, Bar Salts e-liquids are available in a 10ml format, allowing vapers to enjoy their favourite flavours for longer while reducing plastic waste. Available in 0mg, 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Blueberry Raspberry Strawberry offers a versatile and flavour-packed option for adult smokers and vapers.
